--- >Experiences are the best part of life, especially when they are enjoyable and full of surprises, and for me there is no better experience than when nature and art come together in one place. --- ![Image_1776123132709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2uN4ro825aPQrCeab6kU163BtF1ch7DgxRptVS9REZb2vXqzxwzJ6R69AdBt6ruyw5.jpg) --- Of all the times I have visited the city’s historic botanical garden, I had never managed to visit its museum, firstly because it was under construction, it is a new addition to the garden’s history, and secondly because I have almost always gone on Sundays, and the museum is closed on Sundays and Mondays. So this is the first time I have been able to visit it and enjoy everything on display in the two buildings. --- ![20260401_152308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xp4QRmtNUaeZGhzcdTEXRWEiP8oP4FXLsCk3HKLhkW3J1gbqBvTmo632LoBrcyUbHjt.jpg) ![20260401_152311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMYapKiJe6yJdZp3Ui1q4P5KWdn7LrPu4wEYQ1FFJYJ631xiNHDjNC5oYrRgpiEL8bA.jpg) ![20260401_152315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFPm7hCB9B7j4mePBUXV4hK4VU8CmLjFGb5tEbTipJaTjVaPT6GSHYBhTLdJFTEXPRX.jpg) ![20260401_152352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAVthcS81wfYDVopRVprRSeNLyGpsdMKoi9myvKXzQAEvhCbvvM8bLJFTXKdV7qSqft.jpg) --- One of the buildings hosts temporary exhibitions, and the one currently on display was wonderful; the other building is dedicated to the botanical collection, and the exhibits there are permanent. The museum is housed in buildings that were already on the site and were refurbished less than ten years ago. Furthermore, it is situated in the heart of the natural surroundings and very close to the palace. --- ![20260401_152405.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245wRpdWjFDW4vUKUMSJQj8pkRZjctVSDAeoR5auq3dmBq6XaZP4ZRoSK6UizpXT9ARDc.jpg)
![20260401_152422.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23viMJCUCecDS6B84aWCuxsqdgwDDXBdfS3JgjsRNT9T9ACD9A3oCSDeXcoycWV7vorjD.jpg)
![20260401_152844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/EonqPuFy7UBGrDdNsmfhxhTGRvf7xDr5BSDca3MYRhd6mX1cPuDvm1ZBtte5Rx7mMpZ.jpg)
--- As I was unfamiliar with the place, my tour began in the exhibition hall; as it was the first day the works were on display, the artist herself was there, putting the finishing touches to the arrangement. --- ![20260401_152444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w387TVp9w8K9UyRDZXKxvZBFG5P6Ch44XNF3rWekJvRLSLKzdNAoQn48tFVFQ3zmXSL.jpg) ![20260401_152606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/AK6aNnguJtP4jTpypz12TrbFXUKcbJErsTwf9atWbV6g4EDTjQPNa3UbChgP2ih.jpg) ![20260401_152557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/AK9SV9K1T4m1vrwq8YskGd6eVt2UemSGePWpwMfEn27LwFP4Et7wTMWEQrLhMcb.jpg) ![20260401_152541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48RtAE3icmWnuxqc9mD7mJr1B2LnsgEYm4rXcLUqF95A76juXSYHZPVhUwbXDRZ8Wc.jpg) --- That room was itself divided into two, and I thought the layout was excellent for the purpose the artist was aiming for. The artist is Jeanne T. Leroy, an interdisciplinary artist, author and art therapist of German and Croatian origin with an international career, who has a keen interest in the complexity of perception, in this case applied to nature in general. --- ![20260401_152454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/AKU6VnvwDipJ6LWesFqXdWFwko3RJnYiZP8dsuqgbxAhYmRy1cSQdanx1P2QZfp.jpg) ![20260401_152437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eopvszidt1bsvFYFHL6izErVtMXfe4fAsNtZ4NopTj8wisaXeUqXcZc49yUN5QRBCjt.jpg) --- She connects the visible with the invisible in her art exhibition, which is why one of the rooms was dedicated to the macro world and the other to the micro world. Inside the rooms, I found explanations relating to both parts of the exhibition, and personally, the part I liked best was the micro section. Jeanne draws inspiration from philosophy, her own thinking and the processes of nature, where her work moves freely between abstraction and figuration, exploring different aspects of biological systems and linking these to human experiences. --- ![20260401_152515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48VjhxRWa3CxqKdWwwSBUvQgQWXJo3tqAeQQi3r8CHKcevjtkRKnK6bFibAJPagsxG.jpg) ![20260401_152620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/EpT73wBFbASbBA4SoaMttDmiH6E7ve76cR8xwiJjXRa9bCrWRcTNPPF1owXTrbz8nyC.jpg) ![20260401_152612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJQfnrdVt1uB6d5Yjb8fHWRb8vECUWHAvhYhSPJY7ZsjoUWBvUpc3hvNU1MZ8Y9iCX7.jpg) --- All her works possess great expressive power, depth and emotional intensity. In the macro section of the exhibition, which features things visible to all of us every day, yet which many of us fail to notice, I found several works, including paintings of animals and insects such as swans, chameleons, flamingos and much more. All of this surrounds us, yet we often fail to notice it. All the works, except for the oil paintings, were behind glass, making it difficult to take photographs, but I did my best. This macro art invites us to pause and look closely, to delve deeper and appreciate the textures, geometry and rhythms of living organisms. All these works were made possible through observation. --- ![20260401_152820.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8yrDTcRXiDeX8vi4LHpsMJhfM9SPdT1yMAMVDW5FzgDqc2MkQEYWvu24TBb9N3sMi8.jpg) ![20260401_152832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqvxAvyrfrbNjUPfnb5eYk4As5ezo2YYVKmExaoTVe3eQJ2H4CKk7hCRhw6NF9mw1Ai.jpg)
![20260401_152746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sxhQBPKSnUe7nwAMMmGzXitiCECy2oE7TXmB44sz1qP4z3ZyhC6K5QjTJVGGL8NiKBH.jpg)
--- But when I entered the micro section of the exhibition, I was utterly captivated. The artist explains that the micro world begins where ordinary perception reaches its limits, that which exists beyond what the human eye can see and perceive. The invisible world that can be seen through a microscope. ---
![20260401_152657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/AKpAqT9rP378hFGQV46HisrVzJfTD1iSWGJukRLNAR486etaVequF7oBvCEYFGJ.jpg)
![20260401_152722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGsBVY8wYB2kGGv1XFo87L64WTdQdiWSAYYVxLBP241uiGGNxD32Z4v7gTvjBs11eYy.jpg) ![20260401_152649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2432MydPXU5xZe9mhvH57Twn83aJR1afbFPg9jCmPoENbxkfx4pansQHStD21wiCind3i.jpg) ![20260401_152708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zbjGPGUtjSJf8QMmdcbNTg78ThJvoghTBZ8gCisYLmBwVErziA41WCXpkEZa3wK5qun.jpg) ![20260401_152715.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJLYHMoHNTLnd1pXVftaa2GuAx4r1uPxn2katEAcL6WSWCCREw5VQ8EiTkcphbwqJYg.jpg) ![20260401_152701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242hj6ymPgbbbCsE5NLUUy6CYkJVxMwd4Pf9Kw6JnhMxJXZkfJxzQwvgCE6MpEnL435HJ.jpg) --- If you look closely at the works, you will realise how beautiful they are, particularly because of the colours and textures, with most of them possessing volume and form within the frame. They look like abstract works when in fact they are expressions of the micro world, the one we cannot see with the naked eye. --- ![20260401_152645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zS9uibjoqUg6FonAWVLmKf6VRLzjt62vGfbLzLXqsayWUdSG1LEhTJxZod8ZKUq5CkT.jpg) ![20260401_152805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ywyvz7fYUYuBobnSP8enSik9hiBZJ9bjcqFJXPfCEbZ6EYEwKuRjTcmFHgLbSVpdJis.jpg) ![20260401_152812.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zSJ9pEM61pMWy3erYbikhgefNiKPxwqFhCEq8711y7i9ET2LGrDRMQxS2BVc2WeofoM.jpg) ![20260401_152755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ynhCJo4Xnfo8BPWLgxYxEGeFaJtbFcojEAVP8WjhawbLcTRC6jpmaqqXdNeairL7gUV.jpg) |![20260401_152731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/AKWwfVy5TjyN331aRu5qREDYJMWNtSBTEGWZ2jxdDRu79GbPyQBgGtm5sGpgTH4.jpg)|![20260401_152738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2oHjMo4cv5bm39hxobViuyRsakMXNpAvZEFcMYgWEsE3nT1oY841khFAfXktU8yMKq.jpg)| |-|-| --- The artist does not seek to illustrate scientific facts but to convey the experience of discovery. She invites us to reconsider how knowledge is constructed, where observation becomes exploration. Each of the works is more beautiful than the next, and all were delicately lit. It was brilliant to have the artist there in person, something that had never happened to me before. That’s why I was telling you about those unique experiences. ---
![20260401_152928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/AK2FKi64M7NKqTnbvnTWLpnevKNnFgVzj5RU55eq7saD3Vp4kbW82BxDwfi53x9.jpg)
![20260401_152942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVPfxLnXAWPyWDj1c6WNFzhc5K1iMXcTnr4yNojL3trC4RBDdAAFsZipS6TyBaNg24B.jpg) ![20260401_153024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJSzPkLghHz12HG49ytZjiMyWGQBidk7VPx6EinJEFqHB1g4Bttk5pcGVWrUZTZ1rxT.jpg) ![20260401_153003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yTjZKAJDGVKbTVCUGahWYxwDKbBMb5mPguFCroAUS5kk6wCcRorgtHRSrR4U5kYX3uZ.jpg) ![20260401_153016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCGJFV7c5oBc2tYjER2r3brAGuqYY1S1LPdfM4bkM1fr4DJThC3WCgLuJ1DQWb4fyKZ.jpg) ![20260401_153046.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23viCmdmMNsvFEq29nuiMbpxUfJYMkAWbCvpPHxdRoduN4MyRnBdY2PWYszciiNrU2pBW.jpg) ![20260401_153033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y96gpB3iTn5u7dSmNgtazBRMn8GsxVWa9NonJaYZPi9TpoX1Ap2GNdUhdcQANhpHJ8G.jpg) ![20260401_153040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyfjvjPvc72J543MLnmeH2KUAPQgDCRjngYT6ZQF159T39X64wtav8j9LLFka3k76Jv.jpg) --- As I left that building, right opposite, I found the botanical collection, and upon entering, the first thing I saw was a large collection of tree trunks from various species. The display was arranged in a U-shape on white platforms that really brought out the best in each item. --- ![20260401_153058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u6HhoaSHyMYR4VYyqHSvM44zxaDfC69CLhkMGCMrNAGmVHk1fYtWhoVEH8kQ26pKENn.jpg) ![20260401_153104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tSmE6ckcB4eQfnqcaDKKAYSXGGabj4kC14VnpEfeAxKC41YD3jJ6Ly3EYTpuPK2cp2S.jpg) ![20260401_153111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMj93su7cihDWSZPTvBk2SQc7gHDRsfsKg7Vxx77VHbiF4cHkGingrKx2tprZWRwCvR.jpg) ![20260401_153117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tc5ot4Zb7s4rxzTJdQAMKVrtiH2YGCJjAsQLrvYhNRVDu1k2ob7Ya5xpFWw28uLaJpG.jpg) --- I noticed that a wide variety of tree trunks from the different species found in the botanical garden were on display, but I also spotted a large collection of seeds to one side. It was truly impressive. --- ![20260401_153130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMMyj4zAn1Pai6coCrNJ6ZzMK8C44Azh19iFioKJ1uY5z3VVnY2JVBNvLkqFhSTqQ7D.jpg) --- Looking just behind me, there was a large sign in both Spanish and English explaining what this wonderful botanical exhibition was all about. It tells of the Loring family and their passion for collecting, particularly archaeological collections, which are now on display in the city museum or the Customs House; but the botanical garden itself is also a magnificent exhibition, given the wealth of exotic plants it contains. During the 16th and 17th centuries, the collections became part of what was known as the ‘chamber of wonders’ or ‘cabinet of curiosities’, containing numerous rare and unique objects from the natural world, including animals, minerals and plants. All these objects were the result of expeditions and journeys from which large numbers were brought back. The most famous naturalist was Darwin. --- ![20260401_153142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMhBnYJhaHvVHKAV4Wh7n8qjdaPPoE2H8fNwpRhGaodfMTCq6RLPA7ozFc3EbpMopty.jpg) ![20260401_153208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyZkN4hSEmfQPdUE9ikJpwfDiANNCeYVBRrqBWoGDqxuVjX5XvMzAseoBfKs2GefnJh.jpg) ![20260401_153247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgYHnMSfBz4Hob49FuQ2GqchoAt8ow5xsqUQuzEqUH6cW7mvWnroHWXa5zD1KajwgHN.jpg) ![20260401_153154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xerUPmV6gpC8BaeL8pmevgm7LV2s7qMaASUGgHUKi1EYV4XJQ3JQHFrqcgufWnFu7qU.jpg) ![20260401_153201.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1Fg8TGaUmyj7Kw7jPiM589gMRuVQLuQnTUwVLGp9qoVoQB43zQsZp5oZzdrWaKiLDR.jpg) ![20260401_153214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJRCeW1fT7J6q3Het4BSUUCdazLW85vo1G37nD61Cr7N3xNnJLSGBd94W4tKJ2HF914.jpg) ![20260401_153252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zS9Hy1Vqp4Lc839xEBoGuCpC2ZvxW2Zu8Pax6oUFjwSXN8UbB4YTa2GeiWk5hJejQik.jpg) ![20260401_153219.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJTGn6VyYhzBHozDw5zqws3Rd91AQS89SZCg9b5xTS4SMEatycFCMdKzne8YyoeG4De.jpg) ![20260401_153235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1FYNHab88Gr5SVNQS9u3oBsyEVFyyHf9gTG6S9LTYMcBX2geY2WZywESETvoY5xtJf.jpg) --- Next to that sign, I could see a large display case, or perhaps it was a large room, but it was glazed over so that no one could see the vast array of objects that made up the collections mentioned in the text. I tried to get the camera as close to the glass as possible to avoid any reflections in the photographs. To be honest, it was well worth taking a close look at every corner of that place and every single object, it was wonderful. --- ![20260401_153330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqgD2Vj7roR1u3UaqQQEQuT8k3hvJjnKRVRot5uqC9w1FGHAibkmVyFPAyTuBBQxCSu.jpg)
![20260401_153337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFMUY6JpPj8sWL1ZPBZR2DDpwgBAH5HXsSPkucHhEN7yAdtgqPbAEFAT8gYBvjctx5R.jpg)
![20260401_153343.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgFgJ6Y2Gt2hnL5G62QsY8z7K4A4huPEY7bCqW8rYdjDGoRqRLcsnLd9c263ujp5fAp.jpg) ![20260401_153354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tveDbeTktizP13Q22SNw87RKWxuwc5LYEKv6kiyZbvug1kWesfiTHbG5ptfbRGFj8Qp.jpg) --- An opening in the walls led me into a room that seemed hidden away, a very dark room where the walls were black or very dark grey, but with a purpose: to allow the screens displaying historical information to be seen, and I can assure you there was a great deal of information. The décor of the place was perfect. ---
![20260401_153412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/EoAe5zMnthskhdx1zQtWA22292vWrC5MKgG7uuRWfYFuE6F9Df92Sgue1zgQhg1Uqej.jpg)
![20260401_153423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgeua81XHLu297MMNMdJR1wtEwd6Myx3XptwnWVnsD9qs7N1YxzyzuNyXNeibchefpJ.jpg) ![20260401_153432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tw1nsaipUitKkr2BitqXeVe9C8USr6XnAyXAX86LWDvkdo7Kxepkc32paA8p9ZpWj3G.jpg) ![20260401_153443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xLBEzLYuGZWzH8CubvnuhGs3UCekKVkmoRWpTHZrsEcuynzDwsK28d6EYS3uSRZcHG5.jpg) ![20260401_153447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23viEdc17vdVYSUYh2vZHzBB96G6RgVBkwmLboBNKdvdsifWS9ng6vPgRSSpsyzkQbKgg.jpg) ![20260401_153454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tcAEqJcYh4J8HFLepsKra3DFLMAAmNcLwKaXY4SJduMGrkZVKfFC8yAoZzpRtCLLE87.jpg) ![20260401_153458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1PvHpA7kiQaoTvPBFKRjW2YFFjtHZQMNKQvwyh87psrggKrAj9iPiWEBBKWaon2zfS.jpg) --- On a surface that looked like a table, there was a large screen explaining travelling plants, plants and flowers from different parts of the world, how they have spread across territories, and how they have adapted to the diverse climates of various countries through expeditions. Málaga has a very special climate to which many of the world’s plants have adapted, and this can be clearly seen throughout the garden. --- ![20260401_153511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tmQ1sBNnDYDJKa6ggbmHuAQ3MrTKn97g9764RLnfBkNg9xFnjDvrVT3kS5XB4hzfdDk.jpg) --- Then, on the various walls, there were more giant screens displaying a wealth of information on plant biodiversity, different species, botanical collections and how they have adapted to the city’s climate, a climate that is unique worldwide, as it allows species and flowers, for example, to be preserved all year round; it is practically spring-like for most of the year. These screens provided numerous examples. --- ![20260401_153520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tcCBVtx96KzPcW5wSPSmx4joVkL29prnUFVTyrDZPifEDqPrmoh1r3XBDx6oQS2yEYn.jpg) ![20260401_153527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvngERgrPe3XbPKaXXJfWuT2UgnaizJmXFD8gZwXx5qycXhTYE4LEc2qnyMfhXnNUaK.jpg) ![20260401_153534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvnTms4N37NX1yYeGCebn4ZTKL5uUHWsudkSDEmS4n6wamiVmyAp6zkB4E48iCZ63td.jpg) --- Among the topics covered were: the palm tree collection, the history of the garden, its design, the estate owned by the family, societies, scientists and naturalists, the history of the garden during the 19th century, the city’s ornamental flora, the expeditions of collectors and scientists, and the acclimatisation of plants in Málaga. --- ![20260401_153544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tc7xihU4hV23EgVnnks59upjd5QQ5hu25rkggQ3kW7kDiduXcYuGiFYR4hqerKwL1kT.jpg) ![20260401_153552.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wX7dkzLrrz5ffRvZkPiDU6Fngwkh6Cjkom6GmBVGQsknUkczHi5voG6sAzRLQD6WBYo.jpg) ![20260401_153601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMqZcwheALoPAkbtoss3D4byW6eLhwU5zR3dqvL7Naa95uJm7YBkGvx2XV74L9jfMCR.jpg) ![20260401_153607.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsbDw5dAomipNjJC9G1ztMuggDRbEQE61bKzgkZKDC6p5QSaYh8uKDpwqkaGDp4Tbiu.jpg) ![20260401_153614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tmYu8CD7pBUbsJZr39CCDVbHd6JEzgC2NA9mG8a66VGZWosAHMufhRQxXgVsrJvBPoW.jpg) --- Everything was displayed in both languages, and this museum is visited by a great many tourists, as the garden itself attracts large numbers of people from different countries. It was a masterful exhibition, where you learn a great deal about everything to do with the botanical aspect of the city, and it is well worth a visit. Thank you very much for joining me today; I send you my warmest regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- ---

Hola, mis amigos de worldmappin. Que placer saludarlos. Hoy seguimos con las maravillas de La Habana. Sin pensarlo mucho, ayer me fui a caminar y los pasos me llevaron hasta la Plaza de la Revolución. Pero no para quedarme en el medio, que eso ya lo conozco, sino para subir al Memorial José Martí. Llevaba años sin pisarlo, y ya era hora de volver a subir a su mirador, el punto más alto de La Habana. >Hello, my friends from worldmappin. What a pleasure to greet you. Today we continue with the wonders of Havana. > >Without giving it much thought, yesterday I went out for a walk and my steps led me to Plaza de la Revolución. But not to stay in the middle—I already know that—but to go up to the José Martí Memorial. It had been years since I'd last set foot there, and it was high time to return to its lookout, the highest point in Havana.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmddWdQW7Y8mVTACjC4Z2vbEBLCLqZz6eJUNFv7u26KfzJ/1776189835617.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHGXiY1PwtGSiZGt6e1p1mmaGNiaMauXNBHAugAc5xFc/1776189835730.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQLMSyxsWLJm5RyLPf21Y7CsvhGQX7tFEDwKEa9vDZdZq/1776189835886.jpg)
La mañana estaba con ese cielo azul que solo tiene La Habana. Antes de subir, me quedé un rato mirando la estatua de Martí, sentado en aquel banco de piedra, con la mirada perdida hacia el Malecón. Parece que está pensando en nosotros, en cómo anda la cosa. La gente pasa rápido, pero yo me quedé quieta un rato mirando y admirando la magnificencia del lugar. >The morning had that blue sky that only Havana has. Before going up, I stood for a while looking at the statue of Martí, sitting on that stone bench, his gaze lost toward the Malecón. It seems like he's thinking about us, about how things are going. People rush past, but I stayed still for a moment, looking and admiring the magnificence of the place.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWPvhHtEyFJDwckrZmp6VDLBteXFNfFNdFWHz4W7qZMwc/1776189973514.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWs4az5rA7BpKAsLq4NydK4fMziws44HtebYMZVwAzES/1776189973676.jpg)
Subi por la rampa y ya en la entrada del Memorial, pagué los pocos pesos que cuesta la entrada y comencé mi recorrido por ese sitio de tanto valor histórico para los cubanos. Allí se encuentran muchos objetos que fueron de Martí, fotos, pinturas, documentos y hasta un pedestal donde Martí hablaba. >I went up the ramp and at the entrance to the Memorial, I paid the few pesos the ticket costs and began my tour of this site of such historical value to Cubans. There you'll find many objects that belonged to Martí: photos, paintings, documents, and even a pedestal where Martí used to speak.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSzKJNTKTQQNTHgegGAUUxMYZ6pPG8pD1migQLH7B3nLw/1776190055556.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPdkDi5W5zbQex8xeBW94eJufz88CHg7AUBVhPGacXD3h/1776190056251.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVrkBeP4WTgpikwUb8poc34ZY61E6uPPQnXACN2wExQsp/1776190234995.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc8RNTfgxrnYubsT3rKaunmi6ZevMbfZFWM5S6BoTx1iA/1776190235184.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT7j31DtsD2g6QzXEDLxMkqCsFmqZVmMVqCMboAe5Roid/1776190235334.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSE2papAupCteYKv1SiEfhTLntSGrEbaDVNTa3K7azeiL/1776190235719.jpg)
Hay un detalle dentro del lugar que llamó mucho mi atención, las paredes, todas de verde, el color de la esperanza, están llenas de frases dichas por nuestro Apóstol José Martí, un hombre noble y sabio que vivió para luchar por la independencia de Cuba. Una de esas frases decía: “Ser culto es el único modo de ser libre”. Y otra: "Los Presidentes son para unir y no para dividir". >One detail inside that caught my attention was the walls, all green—the color of hope—covered in phrases spoken by our Apostle José Martí, a noble and wise man who lived to fight for Cuba's independence. One of those phrases read: "To be cultured is the only way to be free." And another: "Presidents are meant to unite, not to divide."
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQfdgppeU4VjGYx7jgXmfnRgWMeY27pPNvScutfSNA4m/1776190330766.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY6YcnyGQi1j7AB9j5hb35U69FFiD1VXrn1eXXwGrucK7/1776190331068.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqEyQiwYeWhNHrktpV62hfJ3n2crbjdZ1qjpSJqoedhq/1776190331386.jpg)
Otros cosa curiosa fue ver un taller donde los niños dibujan, leen y crean. Todo allí es relacionado con Martí. >Another curious thing was seeing a workshop where children draw, read, and create. Everything there is related to Martí.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeoYEQRTPYCfdvePAmc7dck9fFpDN2ZcHQnwpzyGTyBr7/1776190378136.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTCmgTXhgbZ7BniyxigJx4fMSc7aZcpj5MZewW7EEHmrG/1776190378303.jpg)
Luego de mi recorrido por la parte de abajo, me subí en el ascensor, que parece el de un hotel cinco estrellas, para ir al punto más alto de capital cubana. Al llegar arriba, en la punta de la torre, el aire te da en la cara y se te escapa un “ay, Dios mío”. Es algo muy emocionante, desde allí ves toda la ciudad: el Capitolio, el Malecón, los edificios medio descascarados pero todavía firmes, y el mar azul que parece una sábana estirada. >After my tour of the lower part, I got into the elevator—which looks like it belongs in a five-star hotel—to go up to the highest point of the Cuban capital. Upon reaching the top, at the tip of the tower, the wind hits your face and you can't help but say, "Oh my God." It's incredibly moving. From up there you see the whole city: the Capitol, the Malecón, the half-peeling but still sturdy buildings, and the blue sea stretched out like a sheet.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYNUG5VJ3mf6jqJVfFyxp8QomXvBLxiooAqpUiNmCqpCN/1776190478746.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQWgNGYiMi6pkDLrhwYcSyUpHYy5WyjTkYKahvpZvsKs/1776190478894.jpg)
Me dio una alegría el pecho, una mezcla de orgullo y nostalgia. Porque desde arriba, La Habana es un espectáculo belleza, aunque abajo tenga sus problemitas. >A joy swelled in my chest, a mix of pride and nostalgia. Because from above, Havana is a stunning spectacle, even if down below it has its little problems.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNbVtiP1mWak9ymydF5UZXStgAPAmsRhcDf4ZX6DedB9q/1776190620614.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUoGgS4xKv5de9TPBvZ1HnLKDrjxUAxurSXJPAeNbP3iK/1776190620741.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUAkxtzek5AJFUCy7uoTJsPuP2WVpJtzJ8egML1mT9Krj/1776190621264.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPKTxifYneLkQg3V6NmsVKeg6LUDh6HMnCYuJguYTDitq/1776190621708.jpg)
Caminé por el mirador y me asomé a cada lado, a cada uno de los cuatro puntos cardinales y disfruté del maravilloso paisaje. Toqué las losas frías y pensé en la cantidad de gente que ha pasado por ahí. Me senté en un banco de marmol y allí estuve por un rato. >I walked around the lookout, peering to each side, to each of the four cardinal points, and enjoyed the marvelous view. I touched the cold stone tiles and thought of all the people who have passed through there. I sat down on a marble bench and stayed there for a while.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWbVbm1f4vBNmSz2J2pVxNgaWDwze2FnbCTvVRVggjGrz/1776190704331.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYrSseneTW5x1GXLhnTyGJXZFo4Nee6Y7MESkFxr3Jf3/1776190704499.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXhaYAAngYF8JfHyPpdFEuP215ywq4nqLqzEbhQSsybRs/1776190704796.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYtfGYWRtg8zKhAzZi5TwvWratxAAeU4fAYUCzXXk7eQL/1776190704989.jpg)
Bajé más tranquila, como si hubiera soltado un peso. La señora de la taquilla me sonrió y me dijo: “¿Te gustó, hija?”. Y yo le respondí: “Mucho". Esto hay que vivirlo, no solo contarlo”. Ir al memorial es como visitar a un amigo que te recuerda quién eres y para dónde vas, aunque el camino esté lleno de hoyos. >I came down more calmly, as if I had shed a weight. The lady at the ticket booth smiled at me and said, "Did you like it, dear?" And I answered, "Very much. This is something you have to experience, not just talk about." Going to the memorial is like visiting a friend who reminds you who you are and where you're headed, even if the road is full of potholes.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR8LH6TBAijhSMda7yMqq9oJAXf4h6nk5WV47dRE4Jvpe/1776190798623.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZurJnn9rUResy9cMimRFgkWataijr5KfLQR9oRynaTNA/1776190799169.jpg)
Así que si vienes por La Habana, no te quedes solo con la foto de la plaza. Sube, paga la entrada, quédate un rato en silencio. Te lo dice una cubana que encontró allí, entre el viento y las losas frías, una razón más para luchar y para querer a esta tierra. >So if you come to Havana, don't just settle for the photo of the plaza. Go up, pay the entrance fee, stay for a while in silence. Take it from a Cuban woman who found there, amid the wind and the cold tiles, one more reason to fight and to love this land.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRZm1YoSGuYzXRMznhxzpNCBNm9Vi3g8ta8Ynj9FoCpQ/1776190853777.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYPrrEWpAZshFGLNR8NBPfsW5VfnsPTxqLG5Y81EezDo5/1776190853944.jpg) https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJDibgVv7QpnG7cFRyL8RrNKwrY4Tkx4636U9mec4jSH/img_8206.gif Gracias por visitar mi blog Texto e imágenes de mi propiedad Thanks to visite my blog Text and imagen are my own https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmftReAUFLd1o6yeBP8wg9ths82CW6Fpu7doGEYgCEWV/img_7269.jpg

## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ❤️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmePGw5uVxNaSD4Bevx5sjUcZWc9qFkR63EeY7TW5B8iPr/1776177890192.jpg) In this post I will share my experience while traveling around Aceh Tengah,precisely around the center of Takengon city, this trip succeeded in giving me a lot of experience and meaning of life, starting from what I can see and what I can feel, meeting many new people is one of the things that will push our lives to be more advanced, the experience is sought not come by itself, and now I will summarize my experience starting from passing the Bireuen -Tekengon crossroad first. Again and again I have to stop because of traffic jams, of course this traffic jam is caused by natural disasters that occurred in Aceh 4 months ago namely floods and landslides, in front of me there are two temporary bridges that have just been built, of course this bridge is very important because it is the only route between Bireuen-Takengon. From the highway this view looks ordinary and is considered normal, but it is different after I stop and see the view under this bridge. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmai5aKnYUi7H7jSakkiBXvR7pVijEBhXHMFNA3JGddPCS/1776177890258.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfD1m1d8y6aLs1vZcpMcocnztkg5Nx27dVsAAcaB7fiNw/1776177890324.jpg) At that time I also took the time to stop for a moment around the bridge area, there were also many local residents who were willing to volunteer to regulate traffic during the traffic jam, with full curiosity, I started to approach one of the residents and asked about the incident, but the resident immediately asked me to see the view under the bridge first, only then would he give an answer. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS63tGN59aRoMAxJNdsHh1So3N94GXFtiE1muJjQ9csp2/1776177890384.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYUDHvZQWdhasT5e55yezMziQFjW8maHtX9MfoJM8NK2J/1776177890450.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8LxKRQohtnToNYQEksnfUW3swyTUpY4Bv38eSLYSoDL/1776177890518.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfn1QvfHBQ1JKo3zqSfGdboqHTLK9xtEBR5ApR3ZMFce/1776177890603.jpg) This is a sight that really surprised me, where previously this was a river that was very small in size, but look now, it looks like a river with a very large size,but that's not the only problem, this land erosion caused a lot of losses for local residents, there are several houses that have been lost due to flooding and some of them are still seen standing right on the edge of the cliff. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemf5RqsVghhKyoxtoKfbk3xFpHHcgZHReEghhWAaikxf/1776177890678.jpg) After seeing this scene, I immediately approached one of the residents to get the answer. According to the resident's confession, when the big flood came, the scene was very terrifying, the roar of the water was also unimaginable. Several residents who realized that their house was on the edge of the river immediately ran to a safe place,a terrifying scene could also be seen when the land on the edge of the river collapsed, which looked like leaves being carried by the water, but fortunately there were no fatalities at all during the incident. >Oh yes, this is a view that I took from the top of the bridge in Jamur Ujung village, Wih Pesam District, Bener Meriah Regency. After getting this information, I immediately decided to continue my journey. After traveling for about 30 minutes, I finally arrived around the center of Takengon. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbzvgBcpLxct4nh9BzemM3s4UUqMudPDS7RGwxqiMA2ma/1776177890736.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPEpX81bfy16SqS7f1JMtpNGKAnU75uhjArEByfghUT5G/1776177890861.jpg) As usual, the first thing I did when I arrived in Takengon city was to immediately look for a food stall, the reason was not only because I was hungry, but because I really like the taste of typical Gayo cuisine which has a fresh sour-spicy taste and the use of strong spices. After eating and resting, I immediately decided to go around the city, I was happy to see many differences from each region and gave me a lot of experience and meaning of a difference to complement each other. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvVfo9wjiDRXjX2qMjfzq156C6bEhmJMa658xsa62KWD/1776177890800.jpg) Takengon is a city which is also often called the city of a thousand tourist attractions,in this city we can find many tourist destinations from the city center to remote villages. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNsfXJ9LUDvosWG61iZpreHbMThXKDCQSWWx7NWDkrRq9/1776177890926.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS9dXmujp574qZsjdcwhcs8ALDcF7EMRVUu4zeSmYouio/1776177890988.jpg) One of them is the Lukup Badak Riverside tourist destination located in Lukup Badak village, Pegasing District, Aceh Tengah Regency, this place is very famous because it has various facilities, but the most interesting is the white water rafting facility which is also quite famous in Takengon city, anyone can visit this place, if you want a quiet time then you should visit it on weekdays, but if you like crowds then you can visit it on big days. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

If you like other travel posts, you can see them on [Worldmappin Community](https://v3.ecency.com/created/hive-163772) and you can also participate there. If you are curious about the places I have visited so far, you can see them on [my personal worldmappin map](https://worldmappin.com/@riyat) And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

🥇 Gatineau Quebec by @leaky20

Back in 2023 shortly after moving back from France, my wife and I went on vacation to our nations capital, Ottawa Ontario Canada. We had been used to traveling extensively while living in Europe and we decided to try and keep that sense of adventure and excitement alive upon our return. The problem is that Ontario Canada doesn't have a whole lot to offer us in terms of traveling. We both grew up here and/or spent the better part of our lives in the province, so we have pretty much seen all that there is to see, many times over. There also isn't a whole lot to begin with, so it doesn't take long to see all of the highlights.

I was lucky enough to visit on December 31, 2025—a date that holds no particular significance in Buddhism, but because it’s a time of great spiritual energy for many of the tourists visiting Wat Arun, the temple decided to host a free meal. **
INGLÉS
** Greetings fellow travelers, I hope you have a wonderful and blessed day with your loved ones. During my trip to Carúpano, the capital of the Bermúdez municipality in Sucre state, I had the opportunity to visit several beaches, plazas, and some churches located in the historic center, including the Santa Rosa Cathedral, also known as the Carúpano Cathedral. In front of the cathedral is a plaza of the same name, which features several concrete walkways, a beautiful fountain, and ornamental plants surrounding it. In the center of the plaza stands the beautiful fountain. On the day of my visit, the fountain was already running, and it's lovely to watch the water cascade down, continuing its cycle of rising and falling. Besides the fountain, the plaza features a walkway made of mesh fabric, which, according to a local woman, is regularly used in December to display lights and decorations. This becomes a popular spot for taking photos and capturing lovely memories of a visit to the cathedral during the Christmas season. The plaza also has concrete benches where you can rest or simply sit and admire the plaza and the striking facade of the cathedral.
**
ESPAÑOL
** Saludos amigos viajeros, espero que tengan un excelente y bendecido día en unión de sus seres queridos, durante mi viaje a Carúpano capital del municipio Bermúdez, estado Sucre, tuve la oportunidad de visitar varias playas, plazas y algunas iglesias ubicadas en el casco histórico, entre ellas la catedral Santa Rosa, también conocida como catedral de Carúpano, al frente de la catedral se encuentra una plaza homónima, la cual consta de varias caminerías hechas de concreto, tiene una fuente muy bonita y alrededor algunas plantas ornamentales. En el centro de la plaza se ubica la hermosa fuente, el día de mi visita la fuente ya estaba funcionando y es hermoso ver como el agua cae para continuar su ciclo de subir y bajar, además de la fuente , la plaza cuenta con una pasarela hecha con tela de malla, la cual regularmente, según la información de una señora, es utilizada en diciembre para colocar luces y adornos, esta se convierte en un importante punto para hacerse fotografías y guardar lindos recuerdos de la visita a la catedral, en la temporada navideña, la plaza tiene también bancos de concreto dónde puedes descansar o sencillamente sentarte a observar la plaza y la fachada de la catedral que es llamativa.

![photo_20260414_120111_0000](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/243q6dD9FQrfK94qYmDNfhtNtyrUYFXe9unmLnTwj4A5KPZnt1KNmoroEZWTtKuXDnp6U.png)


It was actually really easy to get there because it’s just walking distance from where we were staying. We just put on our slippers and started walking. It felt so nice just strolling along excited and ready to go. Since it was so near we could go back and forth anytime we wanted.
 


![photo_20260414_120111_0001](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23xATtxuz8Sb9QJiE7wJYthwromnQmH9mm75eGCUkhn5ijMbMduvJquWQtfkDnUAisH46.png)



 
The first thing we saw was the big "Baler" sign. It says it’s the birthplace of Philippine surfing. Of course we had to stop and take photos right away. We posed and smiled knowing this was just the beginning of our adventure. It felt official now that we were here.
 

![photo_20260414_120111_0002](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23r1Y6uEnENxChsSnuPUwNoJWu2kQdy2vQ4HPNuQhV8v2vHcqsSdf9zhNnzyDUm537Usw.png)

 
When we finally reached Sabang Beach The view was amazing. Clear blue sky deep blue sea and long stretches of dark sand. It looked like a perfect painting. Everywhere we looked it was beautiful. We just stood there for a moment admiring how peaceful and pretty everything was.
 

![photo_20260414_120112_0006](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/244KK3hbi11iZaR5Tkm7TEtmaU6Ci2SizZ4wRxLDt6Xfr6HSuo6ZL9EYAhcRPHDZJT1Ea.png)

 
We loved walking along the beach. Feeling the cool water on our feet was so relaxing. We watched the waves coming in and out. It was nice to just walk and talk enjoying the fresh air. The beach is so long we could walk for hours and still see something new.
 

![photo_20260414_120112_0005](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/246ai177yHt26wvuQpzkV56fTfcmV2yhG5V1JhJ9Q6zDix5Mg1MJuHrAxstiEYKb6J5e7.png)

 
Since this is the surfing capital there were so many people riding the waves. It was fun watching them. Even if we did not know how to surf just seeing them enjoy the water made us happy. They looked so cool and free. They were also perfect subjects for our photos.
 

![photo_20260414_120113_0011](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23z79mgXZWfw6zKGq1HTQWbDmatf8MWqjWGptmEFA5DsxEZbNLuoMs78yFRuzqT9iqE5T.png)

 
There is this small guardhouse or watchtower near the beach. It’s such a cute spot. We went there to take pictures because the view from there is great. You can see the whole beach and the mountains in the background. It’s one of those places you just have to visit when you come here.
 

![photo_20260414_120112_0003](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23zGQ1B1jsmXFNLjW6T3rUJgivKPHJ43GhcFj68jAUkd73STJswky6pbWhksuoPNefmU8.png)

 
We could not stop taking pictures. Every angle looked good. We took group photos solo shots selfies and candid ones. The background was so nice that every picture turned out great. We just kept clicking away wanting to save every moment and every view.

Hi everyone! 👋

On Saturday, as part of our weekend getaway, we visited Jezeří Castle. This place is a total hidden gem on the slopes of the Ore Mountains. The castle stands directly on the edge of a massive brown coal mine. 🏗️

**

*Ahoj!* 👋

*V sobotu jsme v rámci našeho víkendového pobytu navštívili zámek Jezeří. Tento unikát se nachází na svazích Krušných hor a stojí přímo nad hnědouhelným lomem.* 🏗️

![1000093163.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/AJmsyUt2gn2ZRdNuHeTDmbf4J8NsfX4RFjTP2U2Sdy2gPedHyNRoM4JiGfAfah4.jpg)

https://mapy.com/s/magosodenu

https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z6HahdxPN7UqbMUG8?g_st=ac

Parking about 200m from the castle, followed by a short walk uphill.
The weather was cold and foggy, which actually gave the castle a perfectly mysterious, moody atmosphere.🌫️ 

**

*Parkování je  asi 200 m od zámku, pak kousek do mírného kopce po silnici.
Počasí nám sice nepřálo (mlha a zima), ale zámek měl díky tomu tajemnou atmosféru.* 

![1000092878.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/2423sLzGzKEgxb5uo8WTBvm1m1cZmV5SEsYyen2RKYBTGVLMyBmeAQNJjxEbwjfueJznx.jpg)

Originally a Gothic fortress from the 14th century, it was rebuilt into a Renaissance chateau in 1549. It’s one of the largest in Bohemia, but it has a dark past.
After being nationalized in 1948, it fell into ruin and was even scheduled for demolition in the 80s due to mining. Luckily, the excavators stopped just 500 meters away! 🛑

**

*Původně gotický hrad byl postaven ve 14. století a v roce 1549 přestavěn na renesanční zámek. Je to jeden z největších zámků v Čechách, ale jeho osud byl pohnutý.
Po roce 1948 znárodněn, začal chátrat a v 80. letech měl být kvůli těžbě dokonce srovnán se zemí. Naštěstí se rypadla zastavila jen 500 metrů od něj!* 🛑

![1000092909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/EpvhyDtg8QPxqZtFPG7TEAXqDg7QR56xEGM37472izCMrRaQJHmv5GTcEWgiKUq3r64.jpg)

![1000092881.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23zRw13fJ9xJqtUzsy4fVeHfEPSeN6hvkeRYghTPFFvatAoGC9qKpQTEyuDne57zy3FRB.jpg)

<center> **We took Tour Route 3 because dogs are allowed! 🐶 It’s self-guided, so you can explore at your own pace.** </center>

<center> 🐶🐶 </center>

<center> ***Vybrali jsme si 3. okruh, protože na něj můžou i psi! 🐶 Prohlídka je bez průvodce, takže máte svůj klid.*** </center>

***

The castle is still very much a "work in progress," but the tour completely blew us away. We didn't expect much from the cellars and the ground floor, but the reality was breathtaking. We were just staring in disbelief at every turn! 😮

**

*Zámek se sice stále opravuje a práce je na něm jako na kostele, ale prohlídka nás naprosto dostala. Neměli jsme velká očekávání od sklepení a přízemí, ale realita předčila vše. V každé místnosti jsme jen nevěřícně zírali!* 😮

***

In the cellars, you’ll find fairy-tale creatures and ghosts (the kids will love it! 👻).

We finished the day with a stroll through the castle gardens and a quick snack in the courtyard. ☕🍰

##### *<center> "The spiritual air of a temple on the mountain is more spiritual than the spiritual air of a temple in the city because spirituality sprang from the mystery of nature itself!" — Goodreads </center>*


<center> 💮 🌿 💮 🌿 💮 🌿 💮 🌿 💮 🌿 💮 🌿 💮 🌿 💮 🌿 💮 🌿 💮 🌿 💮 🌿 💮 </center>


We recently made a trip to the Ave Maria Shrine, located on top of a hill in Jordan, Guimaras.
It was a memorable experience filled with beautiful sights and a sense of calm.


![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23xVTmeH9w2ZxSa8AuJidG4MHZVHNLLEzVeMHBNTSYNefTwxG9ucJzEcA59Ldy2eTpHjP.jpg)

| | |
|-|-|
|![4a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23zGcDmjMPXTJK8EAFQsXAcKtvMUoY9kpGjBVo1psGP5KFMCoW4uALD7QdJgigjzKqXSJ.jpg)|![4b.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23x16oifwqMhg2vDA6h8vStSNjdnSjmRJoLRQYa9hhAEYLxP8cnxvdXxtP2ioCBnXTuDY.jpg)|


---
---

Getting to the shrine was an adventure in itself.
The path going up was quite rough and uneven.
It takes a bit of effort to reach the top, but every step is worth it.
Once you arrive, you are rewarded with a truly breathtaking view.
From the hilltop, you can look out over the sparkling blue sea and catch a glimpse of the city in the distance.


![2a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23x1DUQct94U8k1xR4hdYeqqNDEgGnvoiYy4ZiMoxUWxfM9GrKSjgLL6qzpFsYVDq2eHy.jpg)

![2c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/244ofFf9dqKUeTRcCsyCV3TMLrzFiNpofveJL32GKAqsWtWtVMVr3TGsHjA6JD9Phae86.jpg)

---
---

The shrine itself is small and simple, but it is very special.
It is a place where many devotees go to pray for blessings and seek guidance.
Because the space is small, there is a patient line of people waiting for their turn to enter and offer their prayers.
You can see how much this place means to everyone who visits, especially during Holy Week.


![3d.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23xVVQ2qgEWffhBXHo1xdGC47dTF67DtgYW4gPApxw2EQfRDdMfqtPQaKDTDXWWUXF6yd.jpg)

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23zGTpyJ9zXXYnvd4M6ZRReCE2u3rqsVPryiAYmSybRcGyFi7z2vSFZ8hfduEFMUZ7eKV.jpg)

![3c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23ujp93c6nXqm8RMiPa9YccnzbRoUkLuXCZndaMpPaSJ7yMhYWJ8dfWVCWmsEzzDs2Ri6.jpg)

![3b.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23y8qa6eKbhpFipkYVqMFDbqFU7aF3beq8uL7TyLmLX2SWbdkbwXq9FUenp8y3LKBwnfq.jpg)

![3a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/242NWS75M7dWAGDuFCr85zUEpVjH1xb5gLzJrMhNLaHAEp8tkEwhaoM74AdoAmxTYUyvo.jpg)

---
---


Since we visited during a very hot day, we were happy to find that the area is surrounded by tall, leafy trees.
These trees provide wonderful, cool shade that really helps you beat the heat while waiting or walking around.
The combination of the fresh breeze, the greenery, and the quiet atmosphere makes it a perfect spot to relax and reflect.

Behind the shrine were 2 grottos. On the right side is the St. Vincent Ferrer grotto, and on the left side is The Virgin Maria grotto.


![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/24329Wx68wuJc1YgRn2W6ojkyAhxQGV1CDJzeWNszJFfGjTKgbDWgPERwzz4qvoSY6Vbz.jpg)

| | |
|-|-|
|![5b.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/2423qh8UgxoUNftCkEX7XZKhEHVy8NreHWtr1krumuuodWppA6caCEtBmaCsWvg9eXb1i.jpg)|![5a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23zGa4tELLuyHD34QJw17ySjH2tuYCYEqTfAgbzM4QryQncVJLMNLujF61kiuqHnCcYWp.jpg)|


![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23tbnfTZCuDNH1qXKLUZ9H3QKJQJmVYG16M67QFECcoxtXqgDsQDVfEKzqhWF86urvo2U.jpg)

---
---

Our visit to the Ave Maria Shrine was both tiring and peaceful.
If you are ever in Guimaras and looking for a place to enjoy a beautiful view and a quiet moment of prayer, I highly recommend visiting the Ave Maria Shrine.

![20230818_151854~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/243qCzSAdYWSgWVC85j1C5xRdpT5yuX1Y2ZnZypyvYkMVsqXzgCRnbdMtYN2Hyd2LP9bY.jpg)

Back in 2023 shortly after moving back from France, my wife and I went on vacation to our nations capital, Ottawa Ontario Canada. We had been used to traveling extensively while living in Europe and we decided to try and keep that sense of adventure and excitement alive upon our return. The problem is that Ontario Canada doesn't have a whole lot to offer us in terms of traveling. We both grew up here and/or spent the better part of our lives in the province, so we have pretty much seen all that there is to see, many times over. There also isn't a whole lot to begin with, so it doesn't take long to see all of the highlights. 

![20230818_151906~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EqWmkNZy653SvmNzvqXELqXFjSuaNW3gSuHizCUUDtYN9JifXUbcuGoEcmqrf655dhJ.jpg)

<center>Parliament Hill</center>

Nonetheless we decided to make the most of the situation and do some extra long weekends and some day trips touring around parts of the province. 

![20230818_151611~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpVB7BiQGTEXo9z24NBt7jyas21GHRYwnx6PATyDTtKrPFGdgNqnmWqcMMSgGfE4PEK.jpg)

<center>Fairmont Château Laurier (left)</center>

Ottawa was a place that neither of us had been to so it made a lot of sense to go a check it out. 

![20230818_151604~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EqfHsAodA8Zn3EtHe5BmZy8VCjVZZuMGLNA2SYRTVseweo8sSPRvopAy7a9ggoFfh9f.jpg)

<center>Alexandra Bridge over Ottawa River</center>

The city of Ottawa is situated in the South Eastern part of Ontario right on the border of Quebec. Its right next to the city of Gatineau Quebec, which is actually the subject of this post. 

![20230818_151624~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpviQsuXpHUzuHNmXw1FchvVFMBeRW1xcdK3bv4U6oSm43GU1VGPwzHyEs2ifg5G5HC.jpg)

### <center>Gatineau Quebec</center>

<hr>

Gatineau is on the other side of a bridge that spans the Ottawa River. 

![20230818_151618~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpC9PEmYfHHqezzt9Jr6EWE3A4mD9yupet4AgGwFCmRgY2FWeCFA5afGbJ3z9UutUuD.jpg)

<center>Canadian Museum of History</center>

You can walk there from downtown Ottawa in just a few minutes. 

![20230818_150706~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EnuhSrukrbeudwzcGStjBo3b8XV9ieqUuWYaZoV2PND5j4sYGorxsBUBZebfvfiQc5u.jpg)

The two cities are practically connected and if it weren't for the river separating them you wouldn't even know that they were different cities (geography I mean). 

![20230818_145807~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Ep5nG8d9waDAus8diUbf7oW8fibcF2SYwCdLv7nK7TA5w7LKdh9jo1U6Q7AA9Csfrq5.jpg)

<center>Museum of History up Close</center>

There are actually several bridges that cross the river and connect the cities but we went across on the Alexandra Bridge.  

![20230818_145832~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eou99WbgTenmFyeEpTFnfZkL5YtwZkMsthn4MWNQwXqvjT8D5Uamuanvm7TJt5YwbZB.jpg)

It was actually a bit of a hike to where we went in Gatineau but we treated the trip like an excursion for the second day of our trip. 

![20230818_145856~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EqNFDC1BKeQjB5YfSvn4uVyXF1XFYRick2WhNyVvuYRubDdpKmJb9iGjfiDNJrNtx96.jpg)

We took our time and spent a few hours visiting a small park, exploring a very cool neighborhood in the downtown area on Rue Laval (Laval street) where we also ate lunch that day. 

![20230818_133616~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eou9iGXXLszVqYTH6H9imLj2E8FWhsSMotr6Gbcwpu9XL1Czrgn3rt4J5NZqiaaEaGt.jpg)

<center>Fish Tacos</center>

![20230818_131953~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpQxi2upeehZRNPnw211tnFdNfYwKpAzQTyQGc4jcaJ1wjoRGUY3Cm9Gtx2hxgABaLs.jpg)

![20230818_132229~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpJZ7QaqmaUWzRUxzy3Y2W9j8Q9kEeTcHXNo9CMUq83iAhHBTcfPf71Ey2kcMiartFt.jpg)

<center>Do you think that I made her laugh or that she made herself laugh?</center>

![20230818_125016~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/242rwFE7M2iaJE2bWuVbgJY5MRdCiit6mZsVwvK6e1v1SbYrGC2sH4qaQM2aX585sZZBK.jpg)

At the end we hiked a walking path along the river before returning back to Ottawa on the Alexandra Bridge again. 

![20230818_144935~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eou7kaDxFw1TqFL5wxtsTcdekSZDZrgfJd8k8CwsFKG7GJQWEzegVhnZvninQMzMMNo.jpg)

The views of the Capital were particularly stunning from the walking path. 

![20230818_144915~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpV9gUwyc9AYdsDPCyxHfwoDqpxJvKPX736PkXTkDtBFbenCj6oww6AxHbpNtCU4nW3.jpg)

From there you can see the parliament buildings rising up out of the trees from across the water. 

![20230818_145522~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/244eAJK3j1oAAi2bTxorcu1PS6zTi7mmhyaDVmUrzNgZ4gYcUSLZR3mgDqdxyCL4ZWAoB.jpg)

We came across a small neighborhood on Laval street that had a very unique sort of vibe about it. 

![20230818_142145~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpLguKRo73Ljd5VHAwxfLKdmXn1Lhqpcny3xbXo7hiXiaSNS3AFcB14kLLvq7gNhYW6.jpg)

It was lined with rusty red brick homes that housed different restaurants and cafes. 

![20230818_142058~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpT54wW6ZLwBGcf4b7aaF1j3s79cnw4cbAXKkkhvWDAmmeFY5v9Hk525Ry4WpURj5eK.jpg)

The streets were pedestrianized in the small area and were paved with modern day Cobblestones. 

![20230818_130707~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eos1HoEyji76gvkyTZRZrhAzHznp8SuBnCtdprPXMhDEpnSfFAooYLPFtFh9XwuKx6w.jpg)

There were several art installations scatters around and a few large murals on some of the walls of the buildings. It was a colorful and fun little neighborhood. 

![Screenshot_20241116_162813_Photos.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23wWrwaLqvoky1TfjdRKy1BJAmeaqNGPqTrMb49MMNykhmsG18PuPNpEdKBUxaNZh32eb.jpg)

The whole site had a very artsy feel about it that gave off good vibes. 

![20230818_142049~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eos3HY2LZWcv6pXpdN1FrHK6UWnEMRYeYf2Czj4KQGjWbqSjTM1zcwUWeJWDN5ebve3.jpg)

We noticed all of these tongue sculptures stuck to various objects in the area. It was one of the art pieces I was referring to. 

![20230818_142001~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoAezSg6svXzHF3fy3eCzyAzBbuVBwZwfrZfrPJarKJn1u8cp5hvBjVU3sCdGdt6d5v.jpg)

In discussing them with my wife and trying to decypher their meaning she suggested that it was probably something to do with the French language and how the French are known for being very protective of their native tongue, stereotypically speaking. 

![image.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23vscujopaBjCoNrktHWSjzFS5CUNEGDGpRiZBPGLa7HsuEXvDeyomsNPdEdDXGdmukmJ.jpg)

Who can blame a culture for not wanting to lose their language to assimilation though?  

![20230818_130545~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpZSM1h4rmbCKoAgHDVHMywxWRh6bmbbBazWPSRENhwnSVBUD9Vk47fyCLJfZQJYGHq.jpg)

Anyway, this area of the city is also know for its art and typically has an annual art installation set up in the sky above the streets, like a collage of colorful umbrellas as an example. We saw a lot of these in France actually. 

![20230818_130620~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpXKXXwe17uCgLETDj53NVdZ9fR9JDCMRzmHD5n6U28jPX34bSZ74TXJYxXjBRJaEDY.jpg)

This year's piece was a swinging girl. 

![Screenshot_20241115_220924_Photos.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/244KR8T26KR81fCVYGjqzjXQ963V1ZSWtMEWhBvTAxRZd488BeWEgQSzPCYMn74cY69TB.jpg)

#### When you take a creepy photo of her on a swing...

![Screenshot_20241115_220602_Photos.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Ep5njTaWDg7NgRrXqKRxhg6xUKGX5ALSxHynZCRHVuZoPtoDMQswafb5SdxZdkCqDag.jpg)

#### and then she matches your creepiness by being a ghost. 

![Screenshot_20241115_220512_Photos.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/242Y5NiUvPTgL72nUULsAQ6ZLpZEkE8CGFbJ5J8doYgZfT22GbxFbvymYAYFkM9Ya72jr.jpg)

In my mind the girl was a ghost.  

![20230818_130819~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpEJLyF2aSYMuZxHg33UcepriAqPMS6vN2WZimSK2uw5ifN9QdCv586srnKdMVhzqbB.jpg)

The black gloves and hair in front of the face was a nice touch.

![20230818_142024~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpNouhoF8DHHVQsJJFL2z9YGm822bow8cWLV85VtKG7B6ugsWSxKU4xrNkRV8UjT6Yg.jpg)

I like the creepiness. It might have been boring or fake looking otherwise. 

![20230818_130813~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Ep7ufDZs45xhez9bFRdjHaQu6c4XQS7bbsswGSxwo3zFkhWvs3ktYkeFhKR2G6CcEHz.jpg)

### Well thats it for ourtrip to Gatineau Quebec. Eventually our do another post on Ottawa. Until then, thanks for stopping by.

**Hello to all amazing travelers across the globe!** 🤗😍

**Hello to all of my dear friends here and of course to all my dear fellow hivers in this wonderful @worldmappin community!** 👋

**How are you all today? I hope everyone is doing fine right now. It’s been a while since I’ve posted travel blogs and now here I am again, @lj1728 to share another travel story of mine with you all.**💕

![April 2026 Blogs.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23zSDdeA4kPxYQJFaq69L9DYycKZ55H3zRoJNHzeTHHDxA4UHvQPfMHVzT1gtVjWbbQK4.jpeg)

***Last week, my family and I visited the “Our Lady of Peñafrancia Minor Basilica and National Shrine” in the Pilgrim City of Naga in Camarines Sur.*** It had been quite a while since our last visit, so this trip felt extra meaningful for all of us. We were complete–my two brothers, my mother and father, and of course my own little family, my husband and my son. ***Moments like these don't happen often, which made the experience even more special.***

![IMG_5988.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/243zfsodMrJiMBRBKeYapUH9aQuAMEKMqJaLLhrfFeb9Bwykt9bHPFQyeRmvjhLSRAbnc.jpeg)

![IMG_5989.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EpA4UDBe7ZmUvRRxuY6wZ2sq1QGFSqcFSvGgn9omphAzHnw1Jweu5U4TCA8CsFB7LYp.jpeg)

***When we arrived, we immediately felt the peaceful and sacred atmosphere of the place. The church was spacious and beautifully maintained, and you could really feel the sense of devotion from everyone around. One of the most important parts of our visit was climbing up through the stairs at the back of the church so we could get closer to Ina Peñafrancia.*** We patiently made our way through, and when it was finally our turn, we were able to touch and offer our prayers. It was a quiet but powerful moment. Each of us had our own intentions, but we shared the same hope and faith. I also noticed the beautiful stained glass as I walked through the exit door.

![IMG_5992.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wCJKFvQJHT9idkni2kpGWcPQRPXu52VizFKZCiEUeKQmipXWRxXSVoXZHUWnYgqHdEL.jpeg)

![IMG_5998.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wX3FCLd5S7K9AEYXZqJQWTdtjb5BcWxvMfDD5YJnDGNGDZmYzd38qkzHs2kdGYtZFgS.jpeg)

![IMG_5999.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23ydGuvnCZEFCMAepU8TsiCLGeqH6pNRFFCTpMKSsUdr2Wp73EjK3u8mpYBy3d3kMp6aL.jpeg)

***After praying, we took a little time to walk around and appreciate the surroundings. The area was wide and open, allowing visitors to move comfortably despite the number of people. There was a calmness that made you want to stay longer and just reflect.***

![IMG_5997.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EoCjzUwoUbmXMbdtdTPJzJ1NUJqdYSyGmybYLffE1yyvxaYjfXGfk4co4c9mTk1Lfj6.jpeg)

![IMG_6025.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/246b2dNUFvvN19iDfrSq2pUmuUvwjdYSpq8HNX6fiKpvYehKX8nj8uiNMdAtmH12JVAvE.jpeg)

Before leaving we passed by a small shop nearby because my brother wanted to buy a rosary. ***The shop had a lot of items like different kinds of rosaries, religious images, candles, and other souvenirs. It was nice to see many choices, each one unique in design.*** My brother took his time choosing, making sure he picked something he liked and meaningful for him.

![IMG_6006.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23yToVopv4xhLdhWVnJLHb5fUtUbumDAq5AwGWC7JgMmjYwadXxhWXxA7tssRnutyzBmD.jpeg)

![IMG_6005.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23ywyiPqQZNgykjRpzXmmPe975eCQNV9Uqgd7ZFg3s2nY75wVpdD5bFCo5ubYghDAcrsf.jpeg)

![IMG_6009.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vsZMYDKsqiN8ePVfcGCdc1b4PRibSvTKSxpcNYQZ3yNYRYyZEooan8oPNNc1KT8QPLy.jpeg)

***It was a simple yet memorable trip. It wasn't just about visiting the place, but about reconnecting with our faith and spending quality time together as a family.***

![IMG_6012.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EpELCMHCtsJs36kRn6rvX2Tz3J1D3JbKWzqH85ErukZ8NAaysRJsBtj8gwPGff97HXg.jpeg)

**And that's it for today's blog!** 😍

**Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story.** 📖✍️

**This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.**💞

**These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.**👩‍💻

**Lots of love,
LJ💗**
